I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

The allotments of land depicted in Advance Tracing No. Ma/NUL/2021/200 dated 18.03.2022 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the Village of Penalaboda (In F.V.P. 263) in the Grama Niladhari Division of E 413 D Penalaboda in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Naula in Matale District in Central Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Kadigalamukalana – Extent: 1.4851 Hectares North: Kadigalamukalana Claimed by State; East: Kadigalamukalana Claimed by State and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); South:Lot. B and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); West: Kadigalamukalana Claimed by State.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Extent: 0.0072 Hectare North: Lot A and Kadigalamukalana Claimed by State; East: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Kadigalamukalana Claimed by State; South:Lot C and Kadigalamukalana Claimed by State; West: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Kadigalamukalana Claimed by State.

03. Lot ‘C’ – Kadigalamukalana – Extent: 0.2684 Hectare North: :Lot B and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); East and South: Kadigalamukalana Claimed by State; West: Kadigalamukalana Claimed by State and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha). Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands.
